verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents its own token export files, and backup encryption with a password is described as optional, which suggests an unencrypted export is possible. The evidence never says the format is open or human-readable, or that other authenticator apps can import it. The import list covers only migrating into 2FAS. missing for 10: documentation that the export format is open and plaintext-readable, evidence that other apps can import 2FAS exports, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full migration out.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
